$comment: Non-TypeScript files the server reads at runtime, relative to server/src.
`tsc` emits TypeScript and nothing else, so a build without copying these
produces an artefact that typechecks, compiles, and then dies on its first
line with ENOENT. That happened twice, ten minutes apart, the first time the
server was ever started as a process.
JSON rather than a list in either the script or the test, so the copy step
and the guard that checks it read the SAME source and cannot drift.
